arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Clement argued Congress comprehensively regulates the national drug market.
Paul Barnett argued the activity is non-economic and wholly intrastate.
Justice Scalia noted Congress does not want interstate commerce in marijuana.
Justice Stevens asked why the government relies on the possibility of diversion.
